applicability: T031 bounded local-IPC-only tool gateway candidate
statement: When a tool submits a stimulation action, the gateway **shall** route all four allowed actions through the accepted T027 pre-emission guard, T026 journal, and T028 action path; an accepted item **shall** carry persistent synthetic provenance, and a rejected or failed request **shall** emit zero normal-route items.
title: T031 requirement 011
